name: Rovaniemi
tagline: Northern lights, huskies and Santa on the Arctic Circle
summary: Rovaniemi is the capital of Finnish Lapland, right on the Arctic Circle. Cross the line at Santa Claus Village, ride a husky or reindeer sled through snowy forest, hunt the northern lights from August to April, learn about the Arctic at Arktikum, and come back in summer for the midnight sun.
seasonNote: Northern lights from late August to early April; polar night in December; midnight sun in June and July.
arrival: Flights from Helsinki take 1h15; the overnight Santa Claus Express train takes about 10 to 12 hours.
gettingAround: Buses to Santa Claus Village; tours include pickups.
cashTip: Cards work everywhere, even for tiny sums. Tipping is not expected.
foodTip: Sautéed reindeer with lingonberries and mash, salmon soup and leipäjuusto squeaky cheese with cloudberry jam.
buyTip: Sámi crafts, Marimekko and Moomin goods, and Lappish leather.

connections.note: Several flights a day; or the overnight train.
